gloss: end of a consecutive holiday; first day back after a long weekend

definitions.gloss: end of a consecutive holiday; first day back after a long weekend
definitions.explanation: The period immediately following a series of consecutive days off, typically referring to the first working day after a long weekend or holiday period like Golden Week or Obon.

examples.japanese: {連休明|れんきゅうあ}けは{辛|つら}い。
examples.english: The day after a long weekend is tough.

examples.japanese: {連休明|れんきゅうあ}けの{月曜日|げつようび}は{電車|でんしゃ}が{混|こ}む。
examples.english: The Monday after a long weekend is crowded on the trains.

examples.japanese: {連休明|れんきゅうあ}けに{大量|たいりょう}のメールが{溜|た}まっていて、{処理|しょり}するのに{半日|はんにち}かかった。
examples.english: A huge number of emails had piled up after the holidays, and it took me half a day to get through them.

notes:
USAGE:
{連休明|れんきゅうあ}け uses the suffix {明|あ}け, meaning "the period after" or "the end of." This pattern is productive: {正月明|しょうがつあ}け (after New Year), {夏休|なつやす}み{明|あ}け (after summer break), {梅雨明|つゆあ}け (end of rainy season).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連休明|れんきゅうあ}けの{仕事|しごと} (work after the holidays)
- {連休明|れんきゅうあ}けに{届|とど}く (to arrive after the long weekend)
- ゴールデンウィーク{明|あ}け (after Golden Week)
